items.title: 53566_Benjamin F.
items.q: Murray owned the Cadillac. He played at the Cadillac, and that is the time I was running the Dreamland...

ctx.x: And they brought him in as a pianist, and, uh, that was when Jelly Roll left and went to, he says, George Brown's place and took all the movie star trade... "By that time the Cadillac was sure I was the man so I took over half the business, went back in there..."

Murray owned the Cadillac. He played at the Cadillac, and that is the time I was running the Dreamland...no, I don't remember now, I think so. And see, I run the...opened up the music store and one...uh, in '20. Christmas, 1919. And about February or March, we opened the Dreamland, the nightclub. Just a few months--two, three months afterward.

I see. Oh. Yeah, yeah, he makes a distinction between the 1917 and the 1922. I'm sorry. I was running it together here, trying to read fast. He said he'd "often seen my brother-in-law, Bill Johnson"--is that Dink Johnson?
